For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.

verses.text: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.

xrefs.text: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

verses.text: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.

xrefs.text: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.

See, my father, look at the corner of your robe in my hand. For I cut it off, but I did not kill you. Know and see that there is no evil or rebellion in my hands. I have not sinned against you, even though you are hunting me down to take my life.
But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

verses.text: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.

xrefs.text: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
So Michal lowered David from the window, and he ran away and escaped.
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?
Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.

xrefs.text: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.

xrefs.text: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

verses.text: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.

xrefs.text: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.

verses.text: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.

xrefs.text: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.

verses.text: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.

xrefs.text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.

Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.

verses.text: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.

xrefs.text: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.

verses.text: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.

For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
